clf-avc-084.text: A system analyst is setting up network isolation for a set of servers that manipulate regulated credit card data. He needs to set rules that explicitly block a specific range of malicious public IPs before traffic reaches the sub-network of instances EC2. What safety component of VPC must be configured to impose this rule of explicit IP denial?
clf-avc-084.explanation: The Network ACLs function as firewalls statess on the perimeter of the subnets of the VPC and support explicit permission (Allow) and denial (Deny) rules for IPs and blocks CIDR specific.
clf-avc-084.hint: Consider the network firewall of VPC which analyzes traffic in and out of the entire sub-network and allows numbered access control lists with denial actions.
optionRationales: The Network ACLs function as firewalls statess on the perimeter of the subnets of the VPC and support explicit permission (Allow) and denial (Deny) rules for IPs and blocks CIDR specific.

The Security Groups act as stateful firewalls in the instance network interface and support only permission rules (Allow). Any traffic not explicitly allowed is denied by default, making it impossible to create specific denial rules (Deny).
The Internet Gateway is a logical network routing component that connects the VPC to the public internet, but does not have internal rules tables for filtering or blocking granular IPs.
The AWS WAF acts in the Layer 7 inspecting traffic HTTP/HTTPS in edge or balancer resources, without acting in the isolation of traditional low-level network packages of general sub-networks of VPC.

clf-avc-085.text: An insurance company is undergoing a comprehensive international audit and needs to prove that the underlying infrastructure provided by AWS follows in full compliance with the regulatory standards of SOC 2 (Type II). Where the company's governance committee can safely download these signed official documents and third party compliance reports?
clf-avc-085.explanation: The AWS Artifact is the free centralized portal that provides on-demand access to the overall safety and compliance reports of its own AWS, in addition to online agreements with regulators.
clf-avc-085.hint: The key requirement is native Kubernetes compatibility.
optionRationales: The AWS Artifact is the free centralized portal that provides on-demand access to the overall safety and compliance reports of its own AWS, in addition to online agreements with regulators.
ECS uses AWS-specific orchestration APIs.

The Trusted Advisor generates real-time advisory recommendations to optimize user account costs, security and performance, without storing or issuing regulatory certificates or external audit reports.

The AWS Audit Manager helps the customer map and audit their own internal operating controls in the cloud for compliance, without serving as a repository for downloading the official audit reports of the customer AWS.

clf-avc-086.text: A cloud administrator needs to ensure strict IT governance and wants to keep a detailed historical record of all changes made to instance settings EC2, volumes EBS and Security Groups over time. The objective is to allow the team to recover the technical status of a resource at any last date and to verify that it was in accordance with the company's internal guidelines. Which service directly meets this configuration monitoring?
clf-avc-086.explanation: AWS Fargate is serverless compute for containers used with ECS and EKS, eliminating the need to manage the underlying EC2 worker fleet.
clf-avc-086.hint: Think of the serverless compute engine for containers.
optionRationales: Fargate removes server-fleet management for containers.

The CloudTrail capture and record the history of calls from API made in the account (who executed an action), but does not monitor internal relationships and detailed state of hardware properties configuration over time.
The CloudWatch collection of performance metrics, applications logs and real-time usage alarms, not acting in the normative tracking of the inventory of logical IT resource configurations.

The Trusted Advisor check best practices in five categories and alert on current anomalies, but does not store a timeline of historical settings or detailed modifications of technical properties of resources.

clf-avc-087.text: A backend function needs to execute for a few seconds whenever an object is uploaded to Amazon S3, automatically scale with events, and incur no idle-server management. Which AWS compute service is most appropriate?
options: Implement a dedicated physical encryption cluster using the AWS CloudHSM.
Use managed keys from AWS (AWS managed keys) inside the AWS KMS.
Configure symmetric encryption rules no AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.
clf-avc-087.explanation: AWS Lambda runs event-driven code without provisioning servers and automatically scales function executions as events arrive.
clf-avc-087.hint: The AWS KMS offers three types of keys; look for one created by the provider for a specific service and whose life cycle and cost of key storage are 100% managed by AWS.
optionRationales: Lambda is event-driven serverless compute.
EC2 requires server management.

The CloudHSM requires the manual provisioning of dedicated physical applications in the cloud and involves high costs and complex engineering effort, violating the requirement of lower operational effort and zero management cost.
The Parameter Store only stores encrypted parameters and data, depending entirely on AWS KMS in the backend to perform encryption and real life cycle management of encryption keys.

clf-avc-088.text: An application exposes serverless business logic through AWS Lambda and needs a managed public API layer with authentication, throttling, request routing, and monitoring. Which AWS service should sit in front of the functions?
clf-avc-088.explanation: The Parameter Store is designed for centralized and simplified storage of configuration data (such as text without formatting) and encrypted secrets (using SecureString integrated to KMS), being ideal for data that do not require complex logic of native database rotation.
clf-avc-088.hint: Consider the variable capacity management component of the AWS Systems Manager focused on storing logical data for parameterization of systems organized by hierarchical paths.
optionRationales: The Parameter Store is designed for centralized and simplified storage of configuration data (such as text without formatting) and encrypted secrets (using SecureString integrated to KMS), being ideal for data that do not require complex logic of native database rotation.

Although the Secrets Manager manage encrypted data with mastery, its main technical focus and higher cost are justified when there is need for dynamic automatic integrated rotation of key API and complex databases.
The Artifact strictly serves to download legal reports and terms of institutional conformity of the AWS, without any technical relationship with variable repositories or application code.
The GuardDuty is an intelligent engine for detecting invasions and logical threats of machine learning-based networks, not having safe functions or software logical parameters repository.

clf-avc-089.text: During a preventive cybersecurity audit in an account AWS development, the technical team discovered that a EC2 was secretly communicating with an external command and control server (C2) associated with a well-known botnet network on the internet. AWS natively detected this malicious network behavior through automated intelligent analysis of flow logs from VPC (VPC Flow Logs)?
clf-avc-089.explanation: The Amazon GuardDuty monitor network log flows (VPC Flow Logs), API and requests DNS. It is natively integrated with global threat intelligence feeds to alert you to instances EC2 are interacting with known botnets or malicious servers.
clf-avc-089.hint: The load balancer must understand HTTP application content.
optionRationales: The Amazon GuardDuty monitor network log flows (VPC Flow Logs), API and requests DNS. It is natively integrated with global threat intelligence feeds to alert you to instances EC2 are interacting with known botnets or malicious servers.

The Inspector analyzes internal vulnerabilities and outdated software packages in instances, without the native ability to monitor active network traffic metadata to hunt connections with external botnet servers.
GWLB routes traffic through virtual network appliances.

The Shield Standard acts by invisiblely blocking external volumetric attacks directed at the basic network infrastructure of the AWS, not being an analytical tool for internal malware infections in instances.

clf-avc-090.text: A developer is designing a API web and implemented a Security Group associated with the instances of Amazon EC2. To allow legitimate user traffic to reach the servers, he opened the gateway 443 (HTTPS) for the public internet. From the point of view of door management and network traffic in the cloud, what will happen automatically with the response traffic (output) that returns from server to user?
options: Response traffic will be blocked immediately on exit unless an explicit exit traffic rule (Outbound) on the door 443 be manually configured.
The traffic will be diverted in a compulsive way to a Amazon S3 for the purpose of forensic audit of packages by AWS KMS.
The output door will change randomly due to peripheral cybersecurity issues controlled by AWS Shield.
The response traffic will be released automatically, as the Security Groups are stateful and recall the established input connections.
clf-avc-090.explanation: Security Groups This means that changes saved in the input rules are replicated intelligently in the responses, allowing the corresponding output traffic to return transparently without extra rules.
clf-avc-090.hint: The requirement is raw network performance rather than HTTP content routing.
optionRationales: Security Groups This means that changes saved in the input rules are replicated intelligently in the responses, allowing the corresponding output traffic to return transparently without extra rules.
This statesss blockade is characteristic of the Network ACLs (NACLs), and not of the Security Groups, that manage states of open network sessions in an automated manner.
Security Groups filter connections in traffic doors and do not have logical integrations of redirection or physical storage of raw packages within storages S3.
The logical door of the connection TCP/IP remains strict according to protocol HTTPS established pattern and does not undergo automatic random mutations by DDoS protection services.
